picks.reason: This is a price bet more than a projection bet: the Bot and the Book nearly agree on his chance, and +130 pays more than that shared view requires. His blended rate is 3.97 shots a game, and after OTT's defense takes 6.1% off and the league-wide scale adds 2.6%, the Bot projects 3.81, a modest cushion over 3.5. That cushion is thin, though: only 49.09% of his 53 weighted games landed on this side of the line, so his history reads like a coin flip. The Book's no-vig chance is 47.54%, the desk bets 47.6%, and the break-even at these odds is 43.478%, an edge of 4.1 points that comes from the price rather than from any read the market lacks.
picks.risk: OTT's defense already trims him to 3.81, and only 49.09% of his weighted games cleared this line, so a routine three-shot night is roughly as likely as clearing it.
